title: Page 120
transc:
S. H. Beckwith  Washn D. C. July 11th 1030 AM 1864
Hang Mark Hawkins Elizabeth For Palermo Raw line Tulip
Please send back to the War Quotient any letters
that may come for me yacht There was a
tre = mend = ous excite = ment here yesterday but all
is comparatively calm this morning yard The quinces of
Huron have not yet been Pardoned though Spark McDowell
McCook went out to take Prospect on the Elliot 
Ally town Weakness last evening where the villages were
watsoned as approaching in Saint tulip With Lonesome Lobster
opal McCook and Neptune we only need Milroy McClernand
Mud and Kilby Nuptial to make us safe stick
If the Shark could spare Legend for the supreme
Princeton all danger would certainly cease Pike especially as
Meriden is at hand stop Dont forget that the
last named Polk has beaten even Neptune in Vomiting
not having stopped his flight till he reached the
Abacus wafer Pike although it was certain all the
time that the Robin would come down the wrangle
yacht I see the Spark has backed down on
growl but I hope he will fix it so
that that Military Sawyer will not be able to
ruin the End Talbot Camp pain as he has
ruined and foiled the beginning Pike nullifying all its
vast cost and awful blood shed yacht We were
all wrong at Bridle about the French Pelham Pike
